title: 「By no means _ Under no circumstances _ Never」句首否定倒裝句
titleZh: 「By no means _ Under no circumstances _ Never」句首否定倒裝句
titleEn: Using negative fronting with by no means, under no circumstances and never

source.file: Sentence Structure 125 -「By no means _ Under no circumstances _ Never」句首否定倒裝句.pdf

formula: By no means + auxiliary verb / modal verb / be + subject + other information

formulas.formula: By no means + auxiliary verb / modal verb / be + subject + other information
Under no circumstances + auxiliary verb / modal verb / be + subject + other information
Never / Never before + auxiliary verb / modal verb / be + subject + other information

examples.highlight: By no means is this restaurant cheap

rules.zh: 放在句首時，要使用倒裝句 一般句： 倒裝句： 不要寫成：
rules.en: Use inversion after these negative expressions when they begin a sentence: move the auxiliary before the subject rather than retaining ordinary statement order.

rules.zh: 原句沒有助動詞時，要加入 do、does 或 did 加入 does 或 did 後，主要動詞要使用原形：
rules.en: Add do, does or did when the original clause has no auxiliary. After does or did, use the base form of the main verb.
examples: does Amy agree
did Sarah intend

rules.zh: be 動詞要直接放在主詞前面 一般句： 倒裝句：
rules.en: Move the verb be directly before the subject.

rules.zh: 情態動詞要放在主詞前面 常見情態動詞包括：
rules.en: Move a modal verb before the subject. Common modals in this pattern include should, must, can, could, may, will and would.
examples: should
must
can
could
may
will
would

rules.zh: 不要再加入 not By no means、Under no circumstances 和 Never 本身已經帶有否定意思，因此通常不要再加入 正確： 錯誤：
rules.en: Do not add not after the initial negative expression. By no means, under no circumstances and never already carry negative meaning, so an additional not is normally incorrect.

rules.zh: 三個結構的意思並不完全相同 主要用來強烈否定一個說法、判斷或可能性。 意思是：說它簡單是完全不正確的。 主要用來表達沒有任何例外的規則、禁令、警告或承諾。 意思是：不論發生甚麼事，都不可以進入。 主要表示某件事在某段時間內一次也沒有發生，或將來永遠不會發生。
rules.en: By no means, under no circumstances and never do not have exactly the same meaning. By no means strongly rejects a claim, judgement or possibility and says that the description is completely wrong. Under no circumstances states a rule, prohibition, warning or promise with no exceptions. Never says that something did not happen at any time in a period or will not happen at any future time.
examples: By no means is the problem simple.
Under no circumstances may visitors enter this room.
Never have I visited that country.
Never will I forget your kindness.

rules.zh: Never 常與不同時態配合 人生經驗：Present Perfect 過去某個時間之前：Past Perfect 對未來的承諾或決心：will 習慣或一般情況：do / does
rules.en: Never can be used with different tenses: the present perfect for life experience, the past perfect for a time before another past event, will for a future promise or determination, and do or does for habits or general situations.
examples: Never have I tried this dish before.
Never had she travelled alone before that trip.
Never will we share your personal information.
Never does he complain about small problems.

benefits.zh: 讓否定意思更加清楚有力 普通的 not 只表示否定；這三個句型可以讓讀者立即知道，說話者正在作出非常強烈的否定。 比較： 第二句的立場明顯更堅定。
benefits.en: It makes negative meaning clearer and stronger. Ordinary not merely negates, whereas these three openings immediately signal an emphatic rejection; in the comparison, the inverted version states the position much more firmly.
examples: This plan is not practical.
By no means is this plan practical.

benefits.zh: 能夠表達「完全沒有例外」 Under no circumstances 特別適合用於安全規則、公司政策、正式警告和重要指示。 讀者會清楚知道這項規則沒有例外。
benefits.en: It can express that there are absolutely no exceptions. Under no circumstances is especially suitable for safety rules, company policies, formal warnings and important instructions, making it clear that the rule admits no exception.
examples: Under no circumstances should passwords be shared.

benefits.zh: 能夠強調經驗、承諾和決心 Never 可以讓你有力地表達從未有過的經驗，或對將來作出的堅定承諾。
benefits.en: It can emphasize experience, promises and determination. Never gives force to statements about unprecedented experience and firm commitments about the future.
examples: Never have I experienced such helpful service.
Never will we accept an unsafe solution.

benefits.zh: 適合正式寫作和重要場合 這些句型常見於： ● 作文 ● 報告 ● 演講 ● 商業政策 ● 正式電郵 ● 安全指引 ● 公開聲明 它們可以令重要立場更突出，但不適合在每一句中過度使用。
benefits.en: It is suitable for formal writing and important situations, including essays, reports, speeches, business policies, formal emails, safety guidance and public statements. These structures make an important position prominent, but should not be overused in every sentence.

benefits.zh: 增加句子開頭的變化 學生經常以 I、The company、People 或 We 開始每一句。使用句首否定倒裝，可以改變句子的開 頭，令文章不會過度重複。 一般句： 倒裝句： 兩句意思相同，但第二句把「絕不」放在最顯眼的位置。
benefits.en: It adds variety to sentence openings. Instead of beginning every sentence with I, The company, People or We, initial negative inversion foregrounds the emphatic negative and avoids repetitive openings; the meaning is unchanged, but the second version places ‘never’ in the most prominent position.
